trigger: an operator looks up an expired-cookie denial, the sign-out row or an api_token/management_group row by the session digest
summary: The session_id row said every dashboard request gets the digest. Rows written without a resolved session (expired or unknown cookie, auth.logout), hand-built api_token.* and management_group.* rows, and two gRPC session.* rows leave it empty; login-path rows carry the digest of any presented cookie; old and new values look alike. Also raised downstream by docs-writer, happy-path, consistency-auditor, enterprise-readiness and architect. Fixed in 5ea752edc (row rewritten, fragment clause added).
classification_rationale: the doc sentence contradicts the code paths it describes

trigger: a reader relies on the session_correlator comment about principal_class or the session-store key
summary: The helper comment said principal_class reflects what was presented; inexact for engine principals (re-stamped from the resolved session) and unrelated to the helper. The equality with the session-store key rests on hash_token staying plain SHA-256 and was undocumented. Fixed in 5ea752edc.
classification_rationale: comment adjacent to the helper asserted behaviour the code does not have

trigger: a login request that carries a stale yuzu_session cookie
summary: The comment 'Empty at the pre-session login sites, which is correct there' sat directly above a changed line and is false when a stale cookie is sent at login (the row carries that cookie's digest). Fixed in 5ea752edc.
classification_rationale: unchanged comment beside a changed line contradicts the code

trigger: a maintainer reads emit_event for the empty-cookie guard and the try/catch
summary: Two comment paragraphs in emit_event described the cookie guard and the fail-soft digest, which now live in session_correlator. Narrowed ruling: only those two paragraphs were replaced by a one-line pointer; the rationale paragraph above them is untouched. Fixed in 5ea752edc.
classification_rationale: not false, made stale by the diff

trigger: a digest failure on any of the three call sites
summary: The shared debug text was less specific than the one it replaced. Text changed to name session_id and the outcome (5ea752edc). The level question raised by security-guardian and sre (debug versus warn) was ruled: keep debug, as the replaced block did, because the same cookie was already hashed earlier in the request.
classification_rationale: log text precision; level is a design call ruled by the Architect

summary: No test pinned the documented claim that the audit digest is the session-store key; a hash_token mutation would leave every test green while the documented join breaks. Added a public-API assertion that store.find(sha256_hex(token)) hits, in 5ea752edc.
classification_rationale: coverage of a contract the change ships

trigger: a regression of the empty-cookie guard or the cookie extractor
summary: Mutation survivors: emit_event dropping its guard; a guard keyed on the Cookie header being present; digest regardless of session resolution; extractor not stopping at ';'. Folded cookie-shape cases into existing tests plus one short unresolved-cookie case in 5ea752edc.

trigger: an OOM-class failure in EVP_MD_CTX_new or the digest call
summary: The catch-and-empty branch of session_correlator has no test (also raised by the code-review and adversarial gates). Rejected: sha256_hex is a static non-virtual function, so driving the branch needs a production seam added only for a test; the identical catch has been untested on the analytics path since 2026-08-16. The catch stays (fail-soft).

trigger: a future hand-built AuditEvent assigning a header-derived value to session_id
summary: AuditStore::log persists any session_id text; protection is one helper at the builders. Resolved as no current defect: every assigner is enumerated (three via the helper, the gRPC agent-session sites carry a different identifier by design). A sink validator or grep tripwire is not justified.
classification_rationale: hypothetical future regression; no present defect

trigger: a reader of the ADR-0049 follow-ups after this change
summary: ADR-0049 lists the AuditStore session_id item as an open follow-up; this change closes it. Appended a dated Update note (ADR-0041 convention) in 5ea752edc. docs/analytics-events.md:13 and an optional compliance-mapping clause were not changed (pre-existing and optional).
classification_rationale: the ADR would assert an open item this change closes
